instrument_name: EDD DE 44 2026: Forms and Due Dates, California Deposit Requirements, DE 9/DE 9C due dates, registration, new hire DE 34, DE 542
figure_or_rule_carried: DE 1 registration within 15 calendar days after paying > 100 USD wages in a quarter; DE 34 new/rehired employee within 20 calendar days of start of work; DE 542 independent contractor within 20 days of paying/contracting >= 600. DE 9/DE 9C quarterly due Apr 1/Jul 1/Oct 1/Jan 1, delinquent after Apr 30 2026/Jul 31 2026/Nov 2 2026/Feb 1 2027. PIT+SDI deposits follow the federal schedule: Next-day (accumulated PIT > 400), semi-weekly, monthly (15th of following month, PIT >= 350), quarterly (< 350); EFT settled by 3rd business day after payroll date; all returns, wage reports and deposits electronic (e-file/e-pay mandate). Penalty for failure to deposit 15% of amount due.

instrument_name: EDD DE 44 2026: Meals and lodging values; subject wages vs PIT wages; recordkeeping
figure_or_rule_carried: Meals 2026 (non-maritime, when no contract value): 3 meals/day 15.85; breakfast 3.25; lunch 4.90; dinner 7.70; meal not identified 5.70. Lodging = 66 2/3% of ordinary rental value, min 66.10/week, max 2,038/month (2026). Meals/lodging for employer convenience on premises not subject to PIT. Employee 401(k)-type salary reductions are subject wages (UI/ETT/SDI) but not PIT wages. Church employees: not subject wages, but PIT wages. EDD payroll records kept at least 4 years (8 years for payments to service providers if claiming non-employer).

instrument_name: EDD DE 44 2026: DE 4 rules, supplemental wages, residents/nonresidents withholding
figure_or_rule_carried: Since 2020-01-01 federal W-4 is for FIT only; DE 4 required for CA PIT; no valid DE 4 -> Single, zero allowances (an earlier valid W-4/DE 4 may be kept). Exempt DE 4 valid one calendar year, renew by Feb 15. Supplemental paid with regular wages: aggregate; paid separately: aggregate or flat 10.23% (bonuses, stock options) / 6.6% (other: overtime, commissions, severance, vacation pay). Resident working elsewhere: withhold CA on all wages, credit for other jurisdiction required withholding (withhold excess only). Nonresident wholly in CA: all wages; split: working-day ratio (volume-of-business ratio for commission pay). Household employees: PIT withholding not required unless both agree.

instrument_name: California Labor Code section 226 (itemized wage statement), leginfo text via Wayback 2026-08-31
article_or_section: Lab. Code 226(a)-(j); amended Stats. 2023 ch.866 (SB 332) eff. 2023-10-13
figure_or_rule_carried: Semimonthly or each payment: itemized statement (detachable or separate) with (1) gross wages (2) total hours (except salaried exempt, 226(j)) (3) piece-rate units/rates (4) all deductions (employee-authorised may be aggregated) (5) net wages (6) inclusive pay-period dates (7) employee name and only last 4 SSN digits or an employee ID (8) employer legal entity name and address (9) all hourly rates and hours at each rate; temp services extras. Copy kept >= 3 years in CA. Inspection request answered within 21 calendar days; penalty 50/100 per violation up to 4,000; 750 for inspection failure. Household (residential dwelling) employees excluded (226(d)); public employers excluded except SSN rule (226(i)).

instrument_name: DIR Labor Commissioner FAQ Minimum Wage (MW-2026), Wayback 2026-10-31
authority: California Department of Industrial Relations / Labor Commissioner
article_or_section: Minimum Wage Order MW-2026; Labor Code 1182.12
figure_or_rule_carried: State minimum wage 16.90/hour from 2026-01-01 for all employers (no size distinction) unless a higher industry or local minimum applies; learners 85% of minimum during first 160 hours (nearest nickel); local city/county ordinances may set higher rates, employer follows the most beneficial; DIR does not maintain the local list (points to UC Berkeley Labor Center, tier B). Exempt salary threshold derived: 2 x 16.90 x 2,080 = 70,304/yr (2026).

article_or_section: Labor Code 1182.12(d) annual CPI adjustment, DOF certification 2026-07-31

instrument_name: California Labor Code section 510 (daily and weekly overtime), leginfo via Wayback 2026-01-02
article_or_section: Lab. Code 510(a); amended Stats. 1999 ch.134
figure_or_rule_carried: 1.5x regular rate for hours > 8 in a workday, > 40 in a workweek, and the first 8 hours on the 7th consecutive day of a workweek; 2x for hours > 12 in a day and > 8 on the 7th day. No pyramiding of overtime rates required. Exceptions: alternative workweek schedules (Lab. Code 511, 514 CBA, 554).

instrument_name: California Labor Code section 204 (paydays) and 213(d) (direct deposit by voluntary authorization), leginfo via Wayback
article_or_section: Lab. Code 204 (amended Stats. 2019 ch.508, SB 698, eff. 2020-01-01; snapshot 2026-08-31); Lab. Code 213(d) (amended Stats. 2005 ch.149; snapshot 2022-10-15)
figure_or_rule_carried: Wages due twice each calendar month on designated regular paydays: work 1st-15th paid 16th-26th; work 16th-end paid 1st-10th of next month. FLSA-exempt executive/administrative/professional salaries may be paid monthly on or before the 26th (whole month paid). Overtime paid no later than the next regular payday. Weekly/biweekly/semimonthly payroll satisfies 204 if paid within 7 calendar days after the close of the payroll period. CBA arrangements prevail. 213(d): direct deposit to a bank/S&L/credit union of the employee's choice only with the employee's voluntary authorization (final wages may be paid by authorised deposit).

instrument_name: California Labor Code sections 201, 202, 203 (final pay and waiting-time penalty) and 227.3 (vested vacation payout), leginfo via Wayback 2025
figure_or_rule_carried: Discharge: all earned unpaid wages due immediately (seasonal perishable-food layoffs: within 72 hours). Quit without written fixed-term contract: due within 72 hours, or at quitting if 72 hours notice given; by mail on request. Willful failure: wages continue as penalty at the daily rate up to 30 days (203). Vested vacation (contract or policy) paid as wages at the final rate on termination; forfeiture prohibited (227.3), unless a CBA provides otherwise.

instrument_name: California Labor Code section 246 (paid sick leave), leginfo via Wayback 2025-01-23
article_or_section: Lab. Code 246(a)-(l) as amended by SB 616 (2023), operative 2024-01-01
figure_or_rule_carried: Eligible after 30 days of work in CA within a year; accrual >= 1 hour per 30 hours worked (exempt deemed 40 h/week); alternative accrual >= 24 h by day 120 and 40 h by day 200; use from day 90; carryover required but use may be capped at 40 h / 5 days per year; accrual cap may be 80 h / 10 days; front-load option: 40 h / 5 days at start of each year (no carryover). No payout of unused sick leave at separation (246(g)); reinstatement if rehired within 1 year. Available balance must be shown on the itemized wage statement or a separate writing on each payday ('unlimited' permitted) (246(i)). Pay rate: regular rate of the workweek of use, or total wages excluding OT premium / hours in full pay periods of prior 90 days; minimum increment max 2 hours.

instrument_name: California Labor Code section 224 (authorised deductions) and 351 (gratuities), leginfo via Wayback 2025
article_or_section: Lab. Code 224 (Stats. 1968 ch.559); Lab. Code 351 (Stats. 2000 ch.876)
figure_or_rule_carried: Deductions lawful only when required/empowered by state or federal law, or expressly authorised in writing by the employee for insurance premiums, hospital/medical dues or similar items not reducing the standard wage, or health-welfare/pension contributions authorised by a CBA. 351: tips are the sole property of the employee; no tip credit against wages, no deduction on account of gratuities; card tips paid in full without deducting processing fees.

instrument_name: Judicial Council of California form WG-002 Earnings Withholding Order (Rev. January 1, 2026), employer computation instructions (CCP 706.050)
article_or_section: WG-002 page 1, Instructions to Employer (A)-(C), Steps 1-5
figure_or_rule_carried: Disposable earnings = earnings minus FIT, Social Security, state income tax, SDI and public retirement contributions. Maximum withheld = lesser of 20% of disposable earnings or 40% of disposable earnings above the applicable minimum wage x 48 (weekly), x 96 (biweekly), x 104 (semimonthly), x 208 (monthly); local minimum wage used where higher than the state one. Wage and earnings assignment for support (family court) is deducted first. Order ends after 180 days with no withholding (2 years for higher priority). The leginfo copy of CCP 706.050 found in Wayback (2022-01-21) is the pre-SB 1477 text (25%/50% x 40) and was discarded as stale.

instrument_name: EDD Information Sheet DE 231TE Types of Employment (Rev. 1 5-16)
figure_or_rule_carried: Special populations: agricultural labor UI/ETT/SDI subject, PIT withholding not required but PIT wages reportable; household employment UI/ETT subject once 1,000 cash in a calendar quarter, SDI once 750 cash in a quarter, PIT withholding not required (reportable if registered); ministers/religious orders UI/SDI not subject (elective), PIT withholding not required; church employees UI/SDI not subject, PIT subject; public entity employees UI subject, SDI not subject unless elective coverage, PIT subject; elected officials/legislators/judiciary/National Guard UI/SDI not subject, PIT subject; students working for their school, student nurses, work-study under 22, organized-camp full-time students: UI/SDI not subject, PIT subject; nonresident aliens on F/J/M/Q visas excluded from UI/SDI per CUIC 608 (IRC 3306(c)(19)), PIT subject unless treaty specifies state taxes; temporary agricultural H-2A workers PIT withholding not required; family employees per DE 231FAM; corporate officers subject to all.

instrument_name: EDD DE 44 2026: Form W-2 state boxes, no state W-2 filing, DE 9C content, new-hire DE 34 fields, WARN, UI reciprocal coverage
figure_or_rule_carried: W-2 for TY2026 to employees by 2027-02-01; Box 14 CASDI (or VPDI), Box 16 CA PIT wages, Box 17 CA PIT withheld; do NOT send W-2/W-2C to EDD or FTB (wage data is on the DE 9C); no separate annual reconciliation return. DE 9C quarterly, electronic, filed even with no payroll: per employee subject wages, PIT wages, PIT withheld; wages reported when paid. DE 34 new hire within 20 calendar days of start-of-work date (rehire after >= 60 days separation): employer EDD account no., FEIN, name, address, contact; employee name, SSN, home address, start-of-work date. CA WARN (Lab. Code 1400-1408): 60 days notice of mass layoff, relocation, termination. UI: CUIC 930.1 out-of-state wages count toward the 7,000 base on transfer; CUIC 602/603 reciprocal coverage elections for non-localized multistate workers. Separation: Notice to Employee as to Change in Relationship (CUIC 1089) + DE 2320 at discharge/layoff/leave (email only with opt-in).

instrument_name: EDD Information Sheet DE 231EB Taxability of Employee Benefits (Rev. 12 6-17)
article_or_section: DE 231EB pp.2-4 (UI/ETT, SDI, PIT withholding columns)
figure_or_rule_carried: HSA: employer contributions and employee salary reductions are subject to UI/ETT, SDI and PIT (CA does not recognise HSAs); exempt from UI/SDI when made through a qualified cafeteria plan. 401(k) employee salary deferrals: subject to UI/ETT and SDI, not to PIT. Cafeteria-plan benefits excludable from income: not subject. Dependent care assistance, Sec. 127 educational assistance: not subject. Transit/vanpool/parking up to IRC 132(f) limits: not subject, and for PIT no monetary limit. Group-term life > 50,000: UI/SDI not subject; PIT withholding not required but imputed amount reportable as PIT wages. Registered domestic partner = spouse except where in conflict with federal law.

instrument_name: FTB 2025 Instructions for Schedule CA (540), revised 04/2026: HSA nonconformity and OBBBA nonconformity
article_or_section: Line 1h (employer HSA contribution, W-2 box 12 code W), line 13; Federal Tax Changes under OBBBA
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer HSA contributions (W-2 box 12 code W) added to CA income; federal HSA deduction not allowed (California law does not conform); HSA earnings taxable when earned. In general California R&TC does not conform to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (enacted 2025-07-04) (no CA conformity to federal qualified-tips/overtime deductions). Second source for the HSA rule alongside DE 231EB. A search summary claimed an HSA employer-contribution exclusion for 2026-2030 under recent legislation: NOT verified on any authority page (open question).

instrument_name: California Privacy Protection Agency FAQ (CCPA as amended by CPRA): employee and job applicant data
article_or_section: FAQ: consumers include employees and job applicants; Civil Code 1798.145(m)-(n) exemptions expired 2022-12-31
figure_or_rule_carried: Since 2023-01-01 CCPA rights (know, correct, delete; respond within 45 calendar days, extendable to 90; opt-out within 15 business days) apply to California-resident employees and job applicants of covered businesses; the employment-data and B2B exemptions expired 2022-12-31. Pay-statement SSN rule: only last 4 digits or employee ID (Lab. Code 226(a)(7), US-CAS5-005).

instrument_name: California Child Support Services PUB 307 California Employers and the SDU (06/2026) and IWO Employer Fact Sheet (09/2019)
authority: California Department of Child Support Services
article_or_section: PUB 307 (2026-06-22); IWO Fact Sheet; Family Code 17309.5
figure_or_rule_carried: CA support wage assignments limited to 50% of income after taxes; withholding starts no later than the first pay period after receipt of the IWO; employee given copy of IWO, Statement of Employee's Rights and hearing instructions within 10 calendar days; payments to the California SDU within 7 business days of the pay date, electronically for CA employers (Fam. Code 17309.5); IWO kept 1 year after separation; terminations reported to the LCSA (Termination of Benefits/Employment Notice or IWO page 4); e-IWO available; NMSN: 20/40-day duties; termination for a wage assignment unlawful. Employer administrative fee per payment: NOT verified on a fetched authority page.
